intent: Operators change what one run may spend without a redeploy, and a run already created keeps the ceiling it was admitted under.
observable_outcome: get-context run lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its integration test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When a credit ledger is configured, a Run is admitted only if the Workspace can reserve the run budget in force when it is created: the operator-set ceiling, or the deployment's when none is set. The Run keeps that ceiling in its policy snapshot, and its attempts run under it whatever the setting becomes later; a Workspace that cannot reserve it is refused with credit_balance.
